children.description: Page content, triggers, and Sheet declarations.

stack.description: Controlled ids of open sheets, bottom first. Leave undefined for uncontrolled use.

defaultStack.description: Sheets open at first when uncontrolled.

onStackChange.description: Called when sheets are pushed or popped.

mode.description: auto picks bottom sheets below breakpoint and centered dialogs above it.

breakpoint.description: Width in px of the viewport, or the container when contained, where auto switches to dialogs.

contained.description: Fill the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport.
